description: Always the last line of a run, exactly one per run. Self-contained (repeats envelope fields). Unknown fields are allowed (v1 ignore-unknown rule).

tool_input.description: Shape depends on the denied tool; the contract only fixes its presence, so no type is enforced here.

result.description: Final assistant text (continuations stitched), or the error text.

stop_reason.description: Derived from subtype: success -> end_turn, error_max_turns -> max_turns, otherwise null.

usage.description: Token usage summed over the turn.
